releaseNotes: V984 finalizes Partial Evaluation semantics: when E2 evaluates only part of the port scope, the Condition card is explicitly marked PARTIAL and its coverage line identifies the evaluated scope and remaining not-evaluated ports.

The E2 evaluation-authority post-processor now prevents a partial aggregate Condition such as NORMAL 4/8 from being described as the whole-system or all-port state. Such wording is deterministically reduced to the evaluated-scope Condition plus the remaining NOT EVALUATED port count and revalidated by the unchanged Grounding validator.

The V983 E2 authority, V979-V982 Grounding/format recovery pipeline, comprehensive default AI question, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only authority, AI Data Library, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths remain protected.

en: Partial Evaluation is now explicit in the Condition card (for example NORMAL · PARTIAL) with evaluated-scope coverage and remaining not-evaluated ports.
AI wording can no longer present a partial aggregate Condition as the whole-system/all-port state; partial claims are reduced to E2 evaluated-scope semantics and revalidated.
All established V983 authority and V979-V982 Grounding/format safeguards remain unchanged.
ko: Partial Evaluation 시 Condition 카드에 NORMAL · PARTIAL처럼 명확히 표시하고 평가 범위와 남은 미평가 Port 수를 함께 보여줍니다.
Coverage가 일부인 Condition을 AI가 전체 시스템/전체 Port 상태로 표현하지 못하도록 E2 평가 범위 의미로 결정론적으로 보정한 뒤 다시 Grounding 검증합니다.
V983 E2 Authority와 V979-V982 Grounding/Format 보호 구조는 그대로 유지합니다.
ja: Partial Evaluation 時は Condition カードに NORMAL · PARTIAL のように明示し、評価範囲と未評価 Port 数を表示します。
部分 Coverage の Condition をシステム全体/全 Port の状態として表現できないよう、E2 の評価範囲表現へ決定論的に補正して再 Grounding 検証します。
V983 E2 Authority と V979-V982 Grounding/Format 保護構造はそのまま維持します。
zh-CN: Partial Evaluation 时，Condition 卡片会明确显示如 NORMAL · PARTIAL，并同时显示已评估范围和剩余未评估 Port 数。
当 Coverage 仅为部分范围时，AI 不得将聚合 Condition 描述为整个系统/全部 Port 状态；相关表述会确定性收敛到 E2 已评估范围语义并重新进行 Grounding 验证。
V983 E2 Authority 与 V979-V982 Grounding/Format 保护结构保持不变。
de: Bei Partial Evaluation zeigt die Condition-Karte den Status explizit als z. B. NORMAL · PARTIAL sowie den ausgewerteten Umfang und die verbleibenden nicht ausgewerteten Ports.

Eine Condition mit nur teilweiser Coverage darf nicht als Zustand des gesamten Systems/aller Ports beschrieben werden; solche Aussagen werden deterministisch auf den E2-Auswertungsumfang reduziert und erneut validiert.
Die Schutzmechanismen aus V983 E2 Authority und V979-V982 Grounding/Format bleiben unverändert.
es: En Partial Evaluation, la tarjeta Condition muestra explícitamente estados como NORMAL · PARTIAL junto con el alcance evaluado y los Ports restantes no evaluados.

Una Condition con Coverage parcial ya no puede describirse como el estado de todo el sistema/todos los Ports; la expresión se reduce determinísticamente al alcance evaluado por E2 y se vuelve a validar.
Se mantienen sin cambios las protecciones V983 E2 Authority y V979-V982 Grounding/Format.
